summary: Lamb Weston Holdings filed an 8-K reporting entry into a new RMB 700 million (≈USD 102.9 million) term loan facility by its Chinese subsidiary, Ulanqab Lamb Weston Food Co., Ltd., with HSBC Bank (China) as facility agent, maturing May 22, 2031, at PRC prime plus 0.30%, to refinance existing debt. The company also terminated the prior 2022 facility. This is routine refinancing of subsidiary debt, not a special situation or event-driven securities event; no shareholder vote, tender, or strategic restructuring is involved. No special situation category applies.
